# uCrowds

> > uCrowds provides SimCrowds, a real-time 3D pedestrian simulation engine for crowd management, event planning, and public safety applications.

Founded by Roland Geraerts from Utrecht University, uCrowds develops crowd simulation technology for digital twins, social distancing analysis, and large-scale event optimization. The platform integrates with Unity, USD, and GIS data to simulate pedestrian dynamics for venues, municipalities, and public spaces.

## Key Topics

- SimCrowds simulation engine
- Crowd dynamics and pedestrian flow
- Digital twins for events and venues
- Social distancing simulation
- Public safety and crowd management
- Real-time 3D simulation
- Event planning optimization
- GIS integration and urban modeling
- Roland Geraerts (CEO and founder)
- Unity and USD integration
- Vierdaagsefeesten Nijmegen projects
- Academic research and startup applications
- Crowd prediction and capacity planning

## Overview

- [Simulate your crowds](https://ucrowds.com): Homepage for uCrowds' SimCrowds simulation engine and crowd management tool
- [Portfolios](https://ucrowds.com/portfolio): Project portfolio showcasing SimCrowds applications in crowd management

## Major Projects and Case Studies

- [Optimizing Crowd Flow for Nijmegen's Biggest Event](https://ucrowds.com/blog/2025-07-24-optimizing-crowd-flow-for-nijmegens-biggest-event): Case study: SimCrowds optimizes Vierdaagsefeesten crowd flow in Nijmegen
- [Digital twins for safe events](https://ucrowds.com/blog/2022-01-20-digital-twins): Digital twin for Nijmegen's Vierdaagse events with Gemeente Nijmegen
- [Project Dutch election](https://ucrowds.com/blog/2020-12-11-dutch-election): SimCrowds used to determine polling station capacity with COVID-19 measures
- [World Economic Forum clip](https://ucrowds.com/blog/2020-09-28-world-economic-forum-clip): uCrowds featured in World Economic Forum video on social distancing

## Platform Updates and Features

- [SimCrowds is now available on MacOS](https://ucrowds.com/blog/2024-12-17-simcrowds-is-now-available-on-macos): SimCrowds launches on MacOS with Intel and Apple Silicon support
- [Packaging crowd simulation data for real-time integration with USD](https://ucrowds.com/blog/2024-12-30-packaging-crowd-simulation-data-for-real-time-integration): SimCrowds adds USD export support for real-time integration and collaboration
- [Directional pedestrian movement in SimCrowds: the Passageway block](https://ucrowds.com/blog/2023-09-21-being-in-control): SimCrowds Passageway feature for directional pedestrian flow control
- [Year 2020 in review: interactive simulation](https://ucrowds.com/blog/2020-12-16-year-2020-in-review-interactive-simulation): 2020 milestone: interactive 3D crowd simulation with dynamic obstacles
